name: xh
description: Fast and friendly HTTP client written in Rust - HTTPie-compatible with improved performance

xh.description: Friendly and fast tool for sending HTTP requests with HTTPie-compatible syntax and curl translation
xh.usage:
xh GET httpbin.org/json
xh POST httpbin.org/post name=John age:=25
xh --print=HhBb GET httpbin.org/headers
xh --curl GET httpbin.org/json
